groups.taxon_descr: Non-living detritus.
Marine turtles; no species list documented.
Other marine mammals; no species list documented.
Pinnipeds; no species list documented.
Seabirds; no species list documented.
Pelagic elasmobranchs. No species list documented.
Demersal elasmobranchs. No species list documented.
Pelagic fish with maximum total length >30 cm, adult stanza from 18 months; includes scombrids.
Pelagic fish with maximum total length >30 cm, juvenile stanza; source paragraph mistakenly says demersal, but heading, examples and stanza names establish pelagic.
Pelagic fish with maximum total length <=30 cm, including sardines, thryssa and anchovies.
Psenopsis anomala; definition: Psenopsis anomala.
Final table has one Benthopelagic fish group. Appendix separately describes small <=30 cm and large >30 cm benthopelagic fish; their relationship to the final single pool is not resolved.
Demersal fish with maximum total length >30 cm, adult stanza from 18 months; dedicated groups excluded.
Demersal fish with maximum total length >30 cm, juvenile stanza; dedicated groups excluded.
Demersal fish with maximum total length <=30 cm, except taxa in dedicated groups.
Larimichthys crocea; definition: Large Sciaenidae >30 cm maximum length, adult fish from 24 months.
Larimichthys crocea; definition: Large Sciaenidae >30 cm maximum length, immature fish younger than 24 months.
Agyrosomus spp.; Pennahia spp.; Pennahia (Agyrosomus) argentatus; definition: Small Sciaenidae <=30 cm; Pennahia is explicitly listed despite differing SAU size classes.
Family Serranidae; the final table calls this Adult groupers but supplies no separate juvenile grouper compartment.
Family Lutjanidae.
Family Stromateidae. Other pomfret-like families are excluded from the stated taxonomic definition.
Trichiurus lepturus; definition: Family Trichiuridae, adult stanza from 18 months.
Trichiurus lepturus; definition: Family Trichiuridae, juvenile stanza younger than 18 months.
Saurida tumbil; S. undosquamis; definition: Family Synodontidae.
Family Priacanthidae.
Nemipterus virgatus; N. bathybius; N. japonicus; definition: Family Nemipteridae.
Loligo edulis; L. chinensis; definition: Cephalopoda, dominated by Loligo squid.
Crabs.
Metapenaeopsis palmensis; M. barbata; definition: Shrimps including penaeids; Acetes is explicitly in Zooplankton.
Sessile and other invertebrates, separate from polychaetes, echinoderms, crustaceans and molluscs.
Non-cephalopod Mollusca.
Benthic crustaceans excluding shrimps and crabs; Oratosquilla spp. supplies the P/B estimate.
Echinodermata.
Polychaeta.
Medusae of Cnidaria.
Acetes spp.; definition: Zooplankton; explicitly includes the landed Mo shrimp Acetes spp.
Benthic algae.
Phytoplankton dominated by diatoms, followed by dinoflagellates.
